G99.title: Energy Safety Core | Field Safety Orientation
G99.benchmark: PEC / Veriforce Basic Orientation 7.0, SafeLandUSA and SafeGulf topic benchmark
G99.audience: New and returning onshore field workers; offshore additions depend on deployment
G99.requirement: VNDRLY issues its own Energy Safety Core credential after its learning checks and separate examination. Veriforce cards and SafeLand/SafeGulf recognition require the recognized provider route. Record a partner acceptance decision separately for the exact VNDRLY version and site scope.
G99.renewal: VNDRLY refresher policy and site-specific induction on change; do not invent a universal PEC expiry.

H13.title: Atmospheric Safety | Hydrogen Sulfide
H13.audience: People exposed to potential H2S, with specialist duties separately assigned
H13.requirement: Apply the actual employer H2S plan. Required respirator users need medical evaluation, fit testing where applicable and demonstrated respirator skills. A named H2S Clear credential requires its approved provider.
H13.renewal: Reassess on changed exposure, detector, respiratory equipment or deficient performance; use any required provider/site refresher.

C08.title: Emergency Care | First Aid, CPR and AED
C08.benchmark: Recognized workplace first aid / CPR / AED
C08.audience: Designated first aiders and emergency support personnel
C08.requirement: Use a recognized current first-aid curriculum with instructor-led psychomotor practice and assessment. An online-only knowledge record is not a Red Cross or AHA skills certificate.
C08.renewal: Track the actual provider certificate expiry and skills refresh schedule.

H05.title: Confined Spaces | Entry Team
H05.audience: Entrants, attendants and entry supervisors, with rescue personnel separately qualified
H05.requirement: Employer training must establish proficiency for assigned duties. Rescue services need the applicable capability evaluation, practice and first-aid provisions. Construction uses Subpart AA rather than automatically applying 1910.146.
H05.renewal: Retrain before changed duties/hazards or when proficiency is deficient; covered employee rescue practice at least every 12 months subject to the standard exception.

G87.title: Confined Spaces | Entry Team
G87.audience: Entrants, attendants and entry supervisors, with rescue personnel separately qualified
G87.requirement: Employer training must establish proficiency for assigned duties. Rescue services need the applicable capability evaluation, practice and first-aid provisions. Construction uses Subpart AA rather than automatically applying 1910.146.
G87.renewal: Retrain before changed duties/hazards or when proficiency is deficient; covered employee rescue practice at least every 12 months subject to the standard exception.

H04.title: Energy Control | Authorized and Affected Employees
H04.audience: Maintenance and operations workers within the applicable energy-control scope
H04.requirement: Train against the actual equipment procedure and certify employee name and training date. 1910.147 excludes oil and gas well drilling/servicing and other specified scopes; determine the applicable energy-control requirements before assigning this standard.
H04.renewal: Retrain for changes or deficiencies; periodic procedure inspection is a separate at-least-annual duty.

H08.title: Work at Height | Fall Prevention and Protection
H08.audience: Employees exposed to falls and their supervisors
H08.requirement: Use the applicable general-industry or construction standard and equipment-specific instruction. Construction employer certification identifies trained workers, dates and trainer/employer signature. Rescue planning and competent-person responsibilities remain task specific.
H08.renewal: Retrain when changed equipment/workplace or demonstrated inadequacy requires it.

H08.title: Access Systems | Scaffold Safety
H08.audience: Scaffold users, erectors and competent persons by assigned role
H08.requirement: Users are trained by a person qualified in the subject; erection/alteration duties require their specified competent-person instruction and supervision. Training is role specific.
H08.renewal: Retrain on changed hazards, new equipment or insufficient proficiency.

G88.title: Work at Height | Fall Prevention and Protection
G88.audience: Employees exposed to falls and their supervisors
G88.requirement: Use the applicable general-industry or construction standard and equipment-specific instruction. Construction employer certification identifies trained workers, dates and trainer/employer signature. Rescue planning and competent-person responsibilities remain task specific.
G88.renewal: Retrain when changed equipment/workplace or demonstrated inadequacy requires it.

G88.title: Access Systems | Scaffold Safety
G88.audience: Scaffold users, erectors and competent persons by assigned role
G88.requirement: Users are trained by a person qualified in the subject; erection/alteration duties require their specified competent-person instruction and supervision. Training is role specific.
G88.renewal: Retrain on changed hazards, new equipment or insufficient proficiency.

G88.title: Rope Access | Technician Preparation
G88.requirement: IRATA training and independent assessment, entry conditions and level progression apply. Practical skills and logged experience cannot be replaced by online completion.
G88.renewal: Track actual three-year certification and refresher/progression requirements.

G02.title: Hazardous Operations | Waste and Emergency Response
G02.audience: Covered cleanup, treatment/storage/disposal or emergency-response workers
G02.requirement: Separate 1910.120(e) cleanup, (p) facility and (q) response pathways. General cleanup commonly requires 40 hours plus three supervised field days; limited-task pathways and response levels have different requirements. Record the exact paragraph and role.
G02.renewal: Use the applicable paragraph: covered cleanup refresher is eight hours annually; emergency response requires annual refresher or demonstrated competency.

G51.title: Hazardous Operations | Waste and Emergency Response
G51.audience: Covered cleanup, treatment/storage/disposal or emergency-response workers
G51.requirement: Separate 1910.120(e) cleanup, (p) facility and (q) response pathways. General cleanup commonly requires 40 hours plus three supervised field days; limited-task pathways and response levels have different requirements. Record the exact paragraph and role.
G51.renewal: Use the applicable paragraph: covered cleanup refresher is eight hours annually; emergency response requires annual refresher or demonstrated competency.

G84.title: Hazardous Operations | Waste and Emergency Response
G84.audience: Covered cleanup, treatment/storage/disposal or emergency-response workers
G84.requirement: Separate 1910.120(e) cleanup, (p) facility and (q) response pathways. General cleanup commonly requires 40 hours plus three supervised field days; limited-task pathways and response levels have different requirements. Record the exact paragraph and role.
G84.renewal: Use the applicable paragraph: covered cleanup refresher is eight hours annually; emergency response requires annual refresher or demonstrated competency.

C06.title: Powered Trucks | Forklift Operation
C06.requirement: Formal instruction, practical training and workplace evaluation by a person with the required knowledge, training and experience are required. Employer certification records operator, training/evaluation dates and evaluator identity.
C06.renewal: Evaluate at least every three years and provide refresher training/evaluation for specified triggers.

C06.title: Cranes | Mobile Crane Operator
C06.requirement: CCO certification involves its eligibility, written and practical examinations. Covered construction operation also requires the employer evaluation under 1926.1427, including equipment configuration and assigned activities.
C06.renewal: Track issuer expiry and employer retraining/evaluation triggers independently.

C06.title: Powered Access | MEWP Operation
C06.audience: Operators of mobile elevating work platforms
C06.requirement: Train and assess on the applicable machine category, then familiarize on the specific machine. IPAF PAL requires approved theory and practical assessment.
C06.renewal: Track issuer validity, equipment familiarization and site reassessment triggers.

C05.title: Commercial Driving | CDL and Endorsements
C05.audience: Drivers of vehicles requiring a CDL
C05.requirement: The state issues the CDL. Applicable ELDT must be delivered through a registered provider; endorsement, medical and security requirements are separate. VNDRLY coursework cannot issue a license or certify unregistered ELDT delivery.
C05.renewal: Track actual state license, medical certification and endorsement expirations individually.

G95.title: Commercial Driving | CDL and Endorsements
G95.audience: Drivers of vehicles requiring a CDL
G95.requirement: The state issues the CDL. Applicable ELDT must be delivered through a registered provider; endorsement, medical and security requirements are separate. VNDRLY coursework cannot issue a license or certify unregistered ELDT delivery.
G95.renewal: Track actual state license, medical certification and endorsement expirations individually.

G79.title: Maritime Access | TWIC Readiness
G79.audience: Personnel needing unescorted access within applicable maritime security areas
G79.requirement: TSA issues TWIC after its identity/security process. There is no VNDRLY training substitute. Record only necessary verification details; do not store background-check material as routine training evidence.
G79.renewal: Use actual card validity and current TSA status, plus facility access authorization.

G92.title: Pipeline Safety | Operator Qualification
G92.audience: People performing covered tasks on regulated pipeline facilities
G92.requirement: Qualification belongs to the operator written program for identified covered tasks. Training completion alone is insufficient. Evaluation must address the task and recognition/reaction to abnormal conditions; record evaluator, methods, task scope and validity.
G92.renewal: Use operator-specified reevaluation intervals and event-driven reevaluation, not a universal OQ expiry.

G63.title: Well Control | Drilling and Well Servicing
G63.requirement: Select the appropriate IADC discipline and level. Accredited delivery, controlled examinations and applicable simulator/practical assessment are required for WellSharp credentials.
G63.renewal: Use the selected course level and issuer validity rules.

G63.title: Well Control | IWCF Preparation
G63.audience: Role-specific wellsite personnel, drillers and supervisors
G63.requirement: Choose the correct IWCF level and surface/subsea combination. Approved-center assessments and applicable prerequisites are required.
G63.renewal: Use current level-specific validity and progression rules.

G61.title: Offshore Safety | Initial Survival
G61.requirement: Select EBS/CA-EBS and regional product variant. Approved-center practical exercises, assessment and medical entry requirements remain necessary for OPITO certification.
G61.renewal: Use current product validity and FOET eligibility, verified for the selected variant.

G61.title: Offshore Safety | Survival Refresher
G61.audience: Personnel holding an eligible current offshore survival credential
G61.requirement: Confirm eligible prerequisite certificate and selected FOET variant before enrollment. Complete approved practical training and assessment.
G61.renewal: Use current variant-specific validity; expired prerequisites need provider review.

G61.title: Marine Safety | Basic Training
G61.requirement: Use Coast Guard-approved training and the applicable mariner endorsement route. Offshore BOSIET is not automatically interchangeable with STCW Basic Training.
G61.renewal: Verify current five-year proficiency/approved refresher or revalidation route and sea-service conditions.

G69.title: Offshore Aviation | Helicopter Escape
G69.requirement: HUET is equipment/variant-specific practical training at an approved center with medical and supervised exercise requirements. Written learning does not demonstrate underwater escape capability.
G69.renewal: Track the actual selected product certificate and refresher requirements.

G70.title: Asset Integrity | Pressure Vessel Inspection
G70.requirement: API determines eligibility from education and relevant experience and administers its examination. Use the examination-window body of knowledge and code editions. VNDRLY cannot waive experience or issue API certification.
G70.renewal: Track API recertification, work requirements and continuing professional development.

G70.title: Asset Integrity | Piping Inspection
G70.requirement: API eligibility and exam apply. Train against the current examination-window reference list and actual piping inspection scope.
G70.renewal: Maintain the actual API renewal, experience and CPD record.

G70.title: Asset Integrity | Storage Tank Inspection
G70.requirement: API eligibility and examination are separate from VNDRLY knowledge completion. Apply current BOK and referenced code editions.
G70.renewal: Track API renewal, relevant work and CPD.

G70.title: Inspection Methods | NDT Level II Preparation
G70.benchmark: ASNT / employer-based NDT Level II, method-specific
G70.requirement: Select method, sector and certification scheme. ASNT examinations and employer written-practice responsibilities differ from ISO 9712 certification. Training/experience hours and practical examinations are method-specific.
G70.renewal: Use the actual scheme, written practice and vision/renewal requirements.

G72.title: Welding Quality | Inspector Preparation
G72.requirement: AWS eligibility, visual acuity and applicable examination parts are required for CWI. The selected code examination and current program rules must be confirmed.
G72.renewal: AWS CWI renewal at years three and six and recertification at nine, subject to current requirements.

G72.title: Fabrication | Welder Qualification
G72.requirement: Qualification requires the applicable code/procedure performance test and acceptance. Record process, position, material and other qualification limits. AWS CWI and welder qualification are different credentials.
G72.renewal: Maintain continuity and requalification under the governing code.

H14.title: Chemical Safety | Hazard Communication
H14.requirement: Employer training must address actual workplace hazards and the written HazCom program. SDS availability alone is not instruction.
H14.renewal: Train at initial assignment and introduction of a new chemical hazard.

H15.title: Respiratory Safety | Respirator Users
H15.requirement: Medical evaluation precedes required fit testing/use; tight-fitting models require applicable fit testing. Demonstrated knowledge and use skills support the employer program. Medical details stay with the appropriate clinician.
H15.renewal: Annual fit testing for tight-fitting respirators and annual training, with additional triggers.

E04.title: Atmospheric Safety | Gas Testing
E04.benchmark: Authorized gas tester / employer gas-testing role
E04.audience: Assigned gas testers and permit teams
E04.requirement: Authorize the worker for actual detector models, sampling arrangements and permit criteria. If OPITO AGT is required, use that approved product and assessment.
E04.renewal: Reassess with instrument/procedure changes, deficient performance and applicable issuer/site expiry.

H06.title: Fire Prevention | Hot Work and Fire Watch
H06.benchmark: Hot-work permit and fire-watch role training
H06.audience: Hot-work operators, fire watches and permit authorities
H06.requirement: Apply the actual hot-work standard and site permit. Fire-watch competence and emergency actions must match the work area; awareness completion is not a permit.
H06.renewal: Refresh when process, materials or emergency arrangements change; follow required post-work watch periods.

H06.title: Fire Response | Extinguisher and Brigade Roles
H06.benchmark: Portable extinguisher education and fire-brigade training
H06.audience: Designated extinguisher users; brigade members separately scoped
H06.requirement: Separate employee extinguisher education from designated firefighting duties and fire-brigade qualification. Training depth and practice depend on assigned response capability.
H06.renewal: Applicable extinguisher education initially and annually; brigade training under 1910.156 has distinct frequencies.

H09.title: Ground Disturbance | Excavation Competent Person
H09.audience: Excavation supervisors and assigned competent persons
H09.requirement: A competent person must identify hazards and have authority to take prompt corrective action. Course completion alone does not grant that authority. Engineering design is required where the standard specifies it.
H09.renewal: Inspect at the required times and after hazard-increasing events; retrain for deficiencies.

G86.title: Ground Disturbance | Excavation Competent Person
G86.audience: Excavation supervisors and assigned competent persons
G86.requirement: A competent person must identify hazards and have authority to take prompt corrective action. Course completion alone does not grant that authority. Engineering design is required where the standard specifies it.
G86.renewal: Inspect at the required times and after hazard-increasing events; retrain for deficiencies.

H07.title: Lifting Operations | Signal Person
H07.requirement: Demonstrate knowledge through oral/written and practical tests under 1926.1428. Employer-qualified evaluator documentation is not portable to another employer in the same way as qualified third-party evaluation.
H07.renewal: Reevaluate when performance or knowledge indicates deficiency.

H07.title: Lifting Operations | Qualified Rigger
H07.audience: Riggers handling loads for assigned lifts
H07.requirement: Qualification must match the actual load, rigging and lift. A generic rigger card does not establish competence for every lift; apply construction requirements where relevant.
H07.renewal: Review for different load/rigging conditions and observed deficiencies.

G75.title: Cranes | Mobile Crane Operator
G75.requirement: CCO certification involves its eligibility, written and practical examinations. Covered construction operation also requires the employer evaluation under 1926.1427, including equipment configuration and assigned activities.
G75.renewal: Track issuer expiry and employer retraining/evaluation triggers independently.

G75.title: Lifting Operations | Signal Person
G75.requirement: Demonstrate knowledge through oral/written and practical tests under 1926.1428. Employer-qualified evaluator documentation is not portable to another employer in the same way as qualified third-party evaluation.
G75.renewal: Reevaluate when performance or knowledge indicates deficiency.

G75.title: Lifting Operations | Qualified Rigger
G75.audience: Riggers handling loads for assigned lifts
G75.requirement: Qualification must match the actual load, rigging and lift. A generic rigger card does not establish competence for every lift; apply construction requirements where relevant.
G75.renewal: Review for different load/rigging conditions and observed deficiencies.

H12.title: Electrical Safety | Qualified Work Roles
H12.audience: Electrical workers and others exposed to electrical hazards
H12.requirement: Apply the governing OSHA scope and employer electrical-safety program. A generic online course does not make someone a qualified person for all equipment or confer an electrical license.
H12.renewal: Review qualification and retraining under the applicable program and adopted standard edition.

G60.title: Electrical Safety | Qualified Work Roles
G60.audience: Electrical workers and others exposed to electrical hazards
G60.requirement: Apply the governing OSHA scope and employer electrical-safety program. A generic online course does not make someone a qualified person for all equipment or confer an electrical license.
G60.renewal: Review qualification and retraining under the applicable program and adopted standard edition.

G67.title: Electrical Safety | Qualified Work Roles
G67.audience: Electrical workers and others exposed to electrical hazards
G67.requirement: Apply the governing OSHA scope and employer electrical-safety program. A generic online course does not make someone a qualified person for all equipment or confer an electrical license.
G67.renewal: Review qualification and retraining under the applicable program and adopted standard edition.

G01.title: Dangerous Goods | Hazmat Employee
G01.audience: Hazmat shippers, packers, loaders and drivers by function
G01.requirement: Employer provides applicable training, testing and certification records under 49 CFR 172.704. A CDL endorsement does not cover every shipping function.
G01.renewal: Recurrent training at least every three years under HMR; use more restrictive modal requirements where applicable.

G50.title: Dangerous Goods | Hazmat Employee
G50.audience: Hazmat shippers, packers, loaders and drivers by function
G50.requirement: Employer provides applicable training, testing and certification records under 49 CFR 172.704. A CDL endorsement does not cover every shipping function.
G50.renewal: Recurrent training at least every three years under HMR; use more restrictive modal requirements where applicable.

G04.title: Exposure Prevention | Bloodborne Pathogens
G04.audience: Employees with reasonably anticipated occupational exposure
G04.requirement: Training must be appropriate to the job and allow interactive questions with a knowledgeable person. Keep medical records separate from routine course completion.
G04.renewal: Initial assignment, annual training and additional instruction for changed exposure tasks.

G53.title: Exposure Prevention | Bloodborne Pathogens
G53.audience: Employees with reasonably anticipated occupational exposure
G53.requirement: Training must be appropriate to the job and allow interactive questions with a knowledgeable person. Keep medical records separate from routine course completion.
G53.renewal: Initial assignment, annual training and additional instruction for changed exposure tasks.

G97.title: Fire Response | Extinguisher and Brigade Roles
G97.benchmark: Portable extinguisher education and fire-brigade training
G97.audience: Designated extinguisher users; brigade members separately scoped
G97.requirement: Separate employee extinguisher education from designated firefighting duties and fire-brigade qualification. Training depth and practice depend on assigned response capability.
G97.renewal: Applicable extinguisher education initially and annually; brigade training under 1910.156 has distinct frequencies.

H17.title: Hearing Safety | Hearing Conservation
H17.audience: Employees included in a hearing conservation program
H17.requirement: Training supports the employer hearing conservation program and does not substitute for exposure monitoring, audiometry or adequate protection.
H17.renewal: Annual training for employees in the hearing conservation program.

H16.title: Dust Exposure | Respirable Crystalline Silica
H16.requirement: Apply construction or general-industry silica requirements to the task. Construction Table 1 methods require the specified implementation; training alone is not exposure control.
H16.renewal: Demonstrate required knowledge and address changing tasks or deficient understanding.

G73.title: Dust Exposure | Respirable Crystalline Silica
G73.requirement: Apply construction or general-industry silica requirements to the task. Construction Table 1 methods require the specified implementation; training alone is not exposure control.
G73.renewal: Demonstrate required knowledge and address changing tasks or deficient understanding.

H19.title: Road Safety | Defensive Driving and Journey Management
H19.requirement: Employer vehicle authorization, applicable license and vehicle-specific practical evaluation remain separate from the knowledge course. This is not a CDL substitute.
H19.renewal: Employer risk-based refresher and incident/deficiency reassessment.
